text:
It is true, it is no tale;
there is a Guardian Angel
who takes you and carries you like the wind,
and goes with children wherever they go.

His hair is soft,
blowing in the breeze;
his eyes are sweet and grave,
they soothe you with a glance
and kill fear by giving light.
(It is no tale, it is true.)

His body, hands, and feet are wings;
the six wings fly or glide,
the six bear you on their beaten air,
and carry you just the same asleep.

He makes the ripe pulp sweeter
that you crush between greedy lips;
he breaks the walnut's sly shell
and saves you from gnomes and witches.

He helps you cut the roses
seated in traps of thorns;
he guides you over treacherous waters
and leads you up the steepest hills.

And though he walks beside you,
like one red cherry beside another,
when sin makes its sign to you
he gathers your soul and leaves your body.

It is true, it is no tale;
there is a Guardian Angel
who takes you and carries you like the wind,
and goes with children wherever they go.

translation.title: The Guardian Angel
